chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Wuhayb, from Abū Baṣīr, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a snake that entered a jar containing water and then came out of it. He said: “If he finds water other than it, then let him pour it out.”

key_terms.حُبًّا: a large water jar or vessel
key_terms.غَيْرَهُ: other than it; an alternative supply
key_terms.فَلْيُهَرِقْهُ: then let him pour it out or discard it

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on water from a vessel that a snake entered and left?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding water into which a snake has entered and then exited. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام instructs that if other water is available, that water should be discarded, indicating caution in matters of taharah and use of water.
